notes:
- New: Premodern format: Bot Play, Casual and Ranked queues, direct challenges, six built-in decks and a daily quest.
- New: Brawl is back: Bot Play and Casual Brawl queues, your commander plays from the command zone, and Brawl and Historic direct challenges.
- New: Undo: mana you tapped and a spell you are still choosing targets for or paying can be undone.
- New: with Full Control or manual mana payment, the "Auto Pay" button is shown so payment no longer looks frozen.
- Fix: clicking a phase-ladder icon to stop once at a step now works.
- New: Booster Tutor and similar cards show the pack as cards in a browser instead of a name search box.
- Fix: Multiversal Passage and other "choose a basic land type" cards now ask you instead of always picking Island.
- Fix: Isochron Scepter's copy (and other spells cast by an effect) asks you for kicker and targets instead of hanging the game; variable energy costs no longer crash.
